findings.title: Waterings filter shows other beds' rows and 'Loading' forever when the filtered request hangs
findings.expected: With 'North bed' selected and the request hanging, the old list is hidden or marked stale, and after a while a timeout error appears
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still shows 'Loading waterings…' under the North bed filter, along with the earlier unfiltered list that includes Shade corner rows. It never times out.

findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' renders a malformed response as rows of 'Never'
findings.expected: A malformed response shows an error in the Recent waterings section
findings.actual: The table shows rows reading 'Never' with an empty bed and '–' amount, and no error. An empty-object response is shown as 'No waterings yet'.

findings.title: Past watering form accepts year 0001 and shows 'Recorded 3 L on 1 Jan 1.'
findings.expected: An impossible far-past date such as 0001-01-01 is refused with a reason
findings.actual: Saved with watered_on 0001-01-01 and the notice 'Recorded 3 L on 1 Jan 1.' The date input has no min and the API has no lower bound.
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Recorded 3 L on 1 Jan 1."],"stored":[{"id":6,"bed_id":1,"bed_name":"North bed","watered_on":"0001-01-01","watered_at":null,"litres":3}]} | {"alerts":["Recorded 3 L on 1 Jan 1."],"stored":[{"id":6,"bed_id":1,"bed_name":"North bed","watered_on":"0001-01-01","watered_at":null,"litres":3}]}

findings.title: Unknown bed in the URL says 'No waterings for this bed' while the select shows 'All beds'
findings.expected: The filter control and the results agree (or the unknown bed is reported)
findings.actual: The Bed select shows 'All beds' but the page reads '0 waterings / No waterings for this bed'. For ?bed=abc it shows the raw validation text 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer...'
